title: Halifax Sightseeing Tour with Peggy’s Cove & Fisherman’s Cove
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy Halifax and Peggy’s Cove in a **small-group, personalized sightseeing experience** rather than a crowded large-bus tour. Our smaller groups allow you to travel comfortably, spend more time at each attraction, and enjoy a relaxed pace.

Explore **Citadel Hill**, discover the iconic **Peggy’s Cove Lighthouse**, and experience the charming waterfront of **Fisherman’s Cove**. Citadel Hill admission is included, and your knowledgeable local guide will share the history, stories, and highlights that make each destination special.

With **comfortable transportation, friendly personal service, and a small-group atmosphere**, we make it easier to enjoy Nova Scotia at your own pace and create unforgettable memories.
